title: dashboard-heatmap-bug-hunt-jordan
body:
3/11-3/13 quick scratchpad for heatmap dashboard bug (customer-facing)

Summary:
Observed intermittent blank/white tiles in the per-customer latency heatmap on /console/dashboards/latency-overview after the rollout of KV-cache v2 on 2026-03-10. Not full dashboard outage; tiles go white for 10-40s then recover. Customer reported during peak (ACME Corp, e-mail thread attached in Slack).

Why this doc: jotting quick repros, queries, hypotheses, and immediate follow-ups so I don't lose steps. Not formal — rough notes.

Timeline (fast notes):
- 2026-03-10 22:05 UTC: KV-cache v2 rollout (auto-scaling PR).
- 2026-03-11 01:30 UTC: first pager flares, hit by internal synthetic checks for dashboards (slo-alert).
- 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC: ACME support case (customer saw blank tiles during a demo).
- 2026-03-11 09:15 UTC: triage meeting w/ Lina and Tom. Repro attempts start.
- 2026-03-12 17:40 UTC: found correlation with spike in prefix eviction events in kv-cache metrics.
- 2026-03-13 11:00 UTC: tried small config rollback on staging; heatmap became stable.

Repro (how I reproduce locally / staging quickly):
1) Open dashboard 'Latency - heatmap by route' on staging (browser: Chrome incognito).
2) Trigger synthetic load: curl loop against /v1/infer?model=redwood-lite (simulating bursts) for 60s.
3) Watch observability: grafana panels for kv-cache eviction_count and redis/redis-ops.
4) Observe heatmap tiles: when eviction_count spikes > 250/min tiles go white for ~20s.

Quick commands / queries to run next time (copy/paste):
- Kibana logs filter: service:console AND "renderHeatmap" AND level:ERROR AND message:/timeout|cache/i
- Metrics (promql): rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[1m]) > 4.2
- BigQuery for user incidents:
  SELECT incident_id, created_at, customer, symptom FROM `redwood-prod.incidents` WHERE created_at BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 72 HOUR) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AND title LIKE "%heatmap%" ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;
- Curl to hit synthetic route: for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST "$CONSOLE_SVC_URL/v1/test-synth" -d '{"prompt":"ping"}' & done

Observations so far (hypotheses):
- KV-cache v2 changes the shard eviction policy; under certain burst patterns it aggressively evicts prefix entries used by the heatmap renderer. When missing prefixes, renderer falls back to full DB lookups which time out or return partial results -> white tiles.
- Possible related: a race between cache warm-up and dashboard tile renderer that expects synchronous responses. Renderer doesn't handle partial/missing tile gracefully.
- Load pattern matters: synthetic bursts and real traffic with many short sequences (LLM small prompts) cause worst behavior.

Immediate mitigation tried:
- Scoped rollback to kv-cache v1 on staging -> heatmap stable.
- On prod, temporarily increased cache capacity by +30% on 3/12 22:00 UTC (hotfix) -> incident frequency dropped but not eliminated.

Proposed fixes (short/med/long):
- Short: increase cache size and raise eviction threshold; add a conservative fallback in renderer (show stale tile + spinner instead of blank). Owner: Tom. ETA: 24-48h for config, renderer quick patch 1d.
- Medium: add circuit-breaker in renderer to avoid waiting for DB fallback; return last-known-good tile if cache miss and DB slow. Owner: Lina. ETA: 1-2 weeks.
- Long: refine kv-cache shard policy to better prioritize prefix keys used by dashboards (affinity hints). Owner: infra/serving-runtime team. ETA: roadmap discussion.

Action items (who, next steps):
- Jordan: run full prod query to list all incidents tagged heatmap + collect example trace ids. (due 2026-03-13 EOD)
- Tom: push cache-size change to prod (increase by 25% and set eviction throttle). Validate with synthetic load. (due 2026-03-14 morning)
- Lina: quick renderer patch to show stale tile w/ spinner on cache miss. Small PR. (due 2026-03-15)
- Ops: schedule controlled KV-cache v2 rollback if config/fixes ineffective. (ops slack: @oncall)
- PM (Alice): notify affected customers with status and ETA for fix (coordinate with support).

Notes on traces / example ids:
- Example trace (prod): trace_id=01f3a9b2... observed when tile blanked 2026-03-11 02:03:14 UTC. Span shows renderer waiting 12s on DB call.
- Tempo link: https://tempo.redwood-inference.internal/trace/01f3a9b2 (put into the Jira RD-4321 ticket)

Customer comms draft (notes to self):
- "Hi ACME team — we investigated the heatmap visual glitch and have identified a cache eviction pattern tied to a recent cache change. We're rolling out immediate mitigations and will follow up with a permanent fix. Apologies for the disruption during your demo; we'll offer a postmortem."

Things to check next triage session:
- Are white tiles correlated to specific customers/tenant size? (maybe larger customer tile payloads expose the bug)
- Which prefix keys get evicted most? (prefix name pattern: dashboard:heatmap:customer:*)
- Does the renderer log a specific error code when it receives partial DB results? search for "renderHeatmap.*partial"

Misc friction / interpersonal notes: Lina is overloaded; keep patches small. Tom can ship infra config quickly. PM wants one-pager for customers once short fix validated.

Links / refs:
- Linked Jira RD-4321 (incident)
- PR draft (staging rollback) https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2147
- Runbook: Confluence obs-runbooks-cache-2025
